_doc: Images pages may use besides the coach's illustrations (seo/data/coach.json). To add one: put the file under assets/img/ and add an entry: id -> src, small (optional smaller copy for cards), width, height and title (what the image shows: it is the alt text). An image narrower than 720 px is shown at its width. The eye-* diagrams are drawn by tools/eye_steps.py. See seo/WRITING.md.
